verdict.rationale: Supabase ships a first-party AI Assistant in the Dashboard that turns natural-language specifications into SQL and schema designs, debugs SQL errors, and can generate and deploy Edge Functions. Its official MCP server also lets AI assistants carry out natural-language operations on a project: querying data, running migrations, deploying functions, pulling advisors, and managing projects and branches. A community report of an assistant operating a Supabase database through MCP confirms this works in practice, though that thread was about a security exploit. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence on the quality and reliability of the Dashboard Assistant, and documented natural-language control of areas like Auth and Storage configuration from inside the Assistant.
